verdict.rationale: AMD's docs describe ROCm as an open-source, Linux-supported GPU computing platform covering compilers, runtimes, and the HIP runtime. The MI325X is listed as a supported gfx942 target, so the user-space driver stack is open and vendor-documented for this GPU. However, the pack never explicitly mentions an open-source kernel module (amdgpu) or upstream Linux kernel support for the MI325X. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux kernel driver support for MI325X, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running it on an open driver.
